resources.string: The receipt goes to them by itself the moment the payment lands — even after they have left.
No tabs yet. Start one when the first order lands.
They scan or tap — the tab opens by itself.
That bill for %1$s is cancelled — nothing to pay.
One itemised bill into your conversation with %1$s. They can pay from anywhere — the thread does not close when they leave.
The tab and everything rung up on it are deleted from this phone. No bill is sent, and this cannot be undone.
Billed. The receipt goes to them by itself when the payment lands. If it was settled some other way, say so here:
They declined this bill. Nothing is coming — cancel it, or say so here if it was settled another way:
Cancelled — they were told in the conversation.
Paid outside DUCAT ✓ — receipt sent, no transaction attached.
Billed, but the bill is still on this phone — it goes out as soon as the network is back. If it was settled some other way, say so here:
The bill never reached them: the conversation was reset before it could go. Cancel it and bill them again, or say so here if it was settled another way:
Cancelled — they have not been told yet. The notice goes out as soon as this phone finds the network.
Cancelled — but the notice never left this phone, and it cannot go now. Tell them in the conversation, or they may still pay this bill.
Paid outside DUCAT ✓ — the receipt is still on this phone. It goes out as soon as the network is back.
Paid outside DUCAT ✓ — but the receipt could not be sent.
Receipt — settled outside DUCAT. Thank you
